sources.summary: Building on nearly a decade of co-engineering, CoreWeave has built NVIDIA compute, networking and software into a cloud purpose-built for AI that’s still returning on investment across multiple generations of deployment. Now, CoreWeave is bringing the next generation of NVIDIA infrastructure to production. At CoreWeave Fully Connected, running this week in San Francisco, CoreWeave announced […]
sources.summary_zh: 基於近十年的共同工程合作，CoreWeave 將 輝達 運算、網路與軟體建構到專為 AI 打造的雲端中，該雲端在多個世代的部署中持續帶來投資報酬率。現在，CoreWeave 正在將新一代的 輝達 基礎設施投入生產。在於舊金山舉辦的本週 CoreWeave Fully Connected 大會上，CoreWeave 宣佈了 […]
